description: Cogitate (2025), a preregistered adversarial collaboration with 256 participants measured with fMRI, MEG and intracranial EEG, found no sustained content-specific synchronization within posterior cortex, which the authors say contradicts the IIT claim that network connectivity specifies consciousness.
limitations: Tests three predictions agreed by the proponents before data collection. Critics hold these predictions are not entailed by the theory itself.

sources.quote: For IIT, a lack of sustained synchronization within the posterior cortex contradicts the claim that network connectivity specifies consciousness.
